chapter: Steely Dan and L.A. session life
title: The Spontaneous Combustion record and its personnel
summary: Scott lists the L.A. studio players on Spontaneous Combustion.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Before I forget I wanted to tell you one of my first early exposures to you was “Spontaneous Combustion.”
That was a very long time ago.

That was a record that featured much of the L.A. studio guys and I think did we have a singer? I can’t remember. Anyway it was like Tom and John Bayler who were singers and John was an arranger also, and gosh Mike Melvoin, Jim Horn on saxophone, again, Ollie Mitchell, Chuck Findley on trumpets, Slyde Hyde. It may have been, I can’t remember who the other trombone player was. Maybe George Bohannon. And who played drums, John Guerin played drums, Max Bennett on bass, I think maybe Larry Carlton on guitar. It was really the cream of the crop rhythm section and horns in those days. © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-
